headline: FS Bancorp Reports Q3 Net Income and Declares Dividend
summary: FS Bancorp reported third quarter net income of $4.9 million, or $0.63 per diluted share, and declared its 55th consecutive quarterly cash dividend.
why: Consistent dividend payouts and stable net income figures are key indicators for evaluating the financial resilience and shareholder value of regional financial institutions.

impacts.name: FS Bancorp, Inc.
impacts.why: Stable quarterly earnings and continued dividend streaks reinforce investor trust in capital returns.
